rules: One canonical asset per meaning. Duplicates stay approved in the Oct 20 lock but are not runtime icons.
Priest position, priest action and priest voice are three independent lanes. Each is resolved from its own source registry at every cue; none is ever inferred from another.
A position picture shows where the priest stands and which way he faces, never what his hands do. An action picture shows what he does, never where he stands.
Movements (ascends, turns to the people, turns to the Missal, turns to the altar) are position transitions. They change the position lane and never produce an action icon.
Example: Collect = position Epistle side + action hands extended + voice chant/aloud. Preface = position centre (Missal on the Gospel side of the centre) + action hands extended + voice chant/aloud.
Every chosen file is pinned by SHA-256. A meaning without approved art stays text-only; nothing substitutes for it.

lanes.faithful_posture: Persistent bodily posture of the faithful (left rail).
lanes.faithful_gesture: Momentary gesture of the faithful at an exact cue.
lanes.response: Spoken or sung response of the people/servers.
lanes.priest_position: WHERE the priest stands and WHICH WAY he faces. Persistent until the next station transition. Never depicts what his hands are doing.
lanes.priest_action: WHAT the priest does with hands, body or sacred vessels at an exact cue. Independent of station: the same action can occur at the centre, Epistle side or Gospel side.
lanes.priest_voice: HOW the priest uses his voice (chant / aloud / low / silent). Independent of position and action.

meanings.title: At the altar, hands extended (orans)
meanings.relaneReason: Hands extended in prayer is an action, not a station. Shown with whichever station is in force (e.g. Collect at the Epistle side, Preface at the centre).

meanings.title: Facing the people, hands extended
meanings.relaneReason: Extending and joining the hands for Dominus vobiscum is an action. "Facing the people" itself is the position (new_priest_facing).
